name: the_real_estate_project
description: This project demonstrates **microservices architecture** with separate authentication service and main application server.

scripts.installall: npm install && cd auth-service && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:auth && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
